name: Thornbury Glasshouses
blurbs: The rarest bloom in the country is about to open, and someone will not live to see it.
Tea on the lawn, prizes for the best marrow and a guest who never came back from the greenhouses.
Everything here is carefully cultivated, including a grudge that has been growing for years.
Beautiful, rare and occasionally poisonous: the plants are not the only dangerous things on the estate.
The judges are tasting the jam, the band is playing, and one exhibitor has been pruned for good.
Under all that glass the air is warm, still and heavy with secrets.
A prize-winning hybrid, a stolen cutting and a rivalry that finally bore fruit.
The estate is famous for its rare specimens. Tonight it gains one more.
Nothing here grows without someone's careful attention, and that includes the gossip.
The head gardener knows which plants can kill. So, it seems, does somebody else.
A rare flower blooms one night a year, and this year it has an audience of suspects.
The heating has failed, the judging is at dawn, and tempers are running hotter than the pipes.
